pattern_1.transformation: Parse campaign collection date from 'Date_Collected' using format '%m/%d/%Y'. Source reports date only (no sub-daily time); assign midnight and label as UTC. Convert to ISO 8601 UTC format.

Approximate a representative depth from the reported depth increment: '0-5 cm' -> 2.5 cm midpoint; '5-15 cm' -> 10 cm midpoint; '15-May' (Excel-corrupted rendering of '5-15') -> 10 cm midpoint; '15 cm +' -> 15 cm lower bound (open-ended, no upper bound reported). All depths approximated from reported ranges; flagged d1.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 1e2 to convert from cm to m.

pattern_1.transformation: Coordinates are reported per row in the data payload. Aggregate (mean) 'Latitude' across all rows for each constructed site_id. Sites whose rows all lack coordinates (Washington_Gulch Upper_Montane plots and the Lower_Subalpine Willow/Veratrum plots) remain unresolved and are flagged g2.

Coordinates are reported per row in the data payload. Aggregate (mean) 'Longitude' across all rows for each constructed site_id. Sites whose rows all lack coordinates remain unresolved and are flagged g2.
Map the source 'Replicate' column (plot/sampling replicate index) to replicate.

No single site-code column exists. Construct a stable site_id by concatenating Location, Field_Site, Block, Plot, and Topographic_Position (pipe-delimited). Topographic_Position is retained because it distinguishes separate sampling footprints (and distinct coordinates) within a plot.

pattern_1.source_pattern: Soil Water Content (g H2O per gram  soil)
pattern_1.transformation: Direct observation of gravimetric water content measured as water lost during a 48 hr oven-dry (per package measurementTechnique). Rename variable. Rows with no measurement value are dropped.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: None; source units are g H2O per g soil.

pattern_1.transformation: None; volumetric water content not reported in source. Populate with NA.
